FedCloudIA provides cloud-based video surveillance systems, access control systems, video storage, body worn cameras, and intrusion detection systems (IDS) to agencies.

FedCloudIA is delivered as a Platform as a Service (PaaS) hybrid solution, or as a Software as a Service (SaaS) offering with agency managed on-site equipment and FedCloudIA managed cloud infrastructure in a multi-tenant Government Only cloud computing environment. It is available to federal, state, local, and tribal governments as well the defense industrial base (DIB). Agency-site equipment is supported by management infrastructure maintained by FedCloudIA and hosted in the Azure Gov Cloud.

FedCloudIA’ s PaaS offering allows agencies the flexibility to distribute resources between cloud and local systems. As a physical security environment, FedCloudIA simplifies the ATO process of multiple commercial off the shelf (COTS) manufacturers such as Milestone Systems, Identiv, and others.
